div.div: 2 بطّح المَسْجِدَ , (TA,) inf. n. تَبْطِيحٌ; (K;) and ↓ ابطحهُ ; (TA;) He strewed pebbles in the mosque, and made it plain, or level [in its ground, or floor]: (K, TA:) and بَطْحُهُ, [inf. n. of ↓ بَطَحَهُ ,] occurring in a trad., also signifies the making it plain, or level. (TA.)
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
